CustomObject.description: REV-60 ALM Promo & Dispatch code automation — per-determinant mapping. One record per determinant key: base promo code + standardised dispatch code, with per-row composition flags (year-suffix, +Z) and a per-row kill switch. Mapping values are seeded in Phase B once the base-promo determinant (spec §7.1) is confirmed. No product codes hardcoded in flow.
